نتقاتل (form VI)
# نَتَقَاتَلُ (nataqātalu) /na.ta.qaː.ta.lu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of تَقَاتَلَ (taqātala)
# نَتَقَاتَلَ (nataqātala) /na.ta.qaː.ta.la/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of تَقَاتَلَ (taqātala)
# نَتَقَاتَلْ (nataqātal) /na.ta.qaː.tal/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of تَقَاتَلَ (taqātala)
